Maria: FYI there's a new latency regression on TP with fused-attn enabled on the 8xA100 pools. Observed 12% p95 increase after kernel-selection heuristic landed in staging.

Simon: repro? nightly or synthetic?

Maria: synthetic lm-infer benchmark (seq_len 512, batch 4) -> run: `./bench/run.sh --model redwood-v3 --tp 2 --fp16 --flash-attn`
Output: p95 72ms -> after patch 80ms

Raj: can you paste perf traces from nsight or perf-bench? sounds like allgather spikes

Maria: attaching short perf snippets:
```
NCCL allgather 0.6ms -> 5.2ms (tail)
kernel: fused_attn_qkv_flash_v2 selected
KV cache serialize step shows extra memcpy between shards
```

Elaine: hmm, kernel selector probably prefers v2 for small sequences; TP causes q/k/v layout to be noncontiguous which triggers a fallback memcopy

Simon: this matches earlier bug where stride != local_dim causes extra gather. Could be that the kernel now assumes packed qkv but TP layout is sharded by dim

perf-bot: benchmark/regression detected: run/1799/seq512-b4 -- p95 +11.2% -- culprit commit c3a4f1a (kernel selector heuristics)

Maria: created minimal repro script in /tmp/repros/tp_qkv_stride.py

Raj: can you run with env var `REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL=fused_attn_qkv_flash_v1` and compare?

Maria: quick run: v1 p95 73ms, v2 p95 82ms

Simon: ok, temporary mitigation -> pin kernel to v1 for TP on sharded-qkv until we fix selector. I'll open PR to add whitelist for tp_layout

Elaine: need regression test in perf harness that covers tp+flash on seq 512 and seq 1024. Also add a microbenchmark to assert no memcpy between shard boundaries (we can add nvtx marks)

Joel: infra-bot schedule: rolling deploy of kernel-selector rollback to staging at 13:00 UTC if PR merged

infra-bot: deploy job queued: job id 54321 -> staging

Raj: quick probe: also check KV cache path when prefixing with cache hits; the allgather pattern is different on cached token generation

Maria: good call. With kvcache hits the p95 jumps to 90ms with v2 (more copies). Suspect code path that repacks cache during allgather is not TP-aware

Simon: plan -> 1) revert heuristic for tp_layout until selector honors sharded strides 2) add unit test and perf test 3) fix kernel to accept strided input or add fast gather 4) monitor perf-bot

Maria: created issue INF-827, linked PR 4123, added reproducer

Elaine: optional: add guard in serving runtime to force coalesced layout before calling v2 (cheap memcopy) as short term

Maria: assigning to @Simon and @Raj. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Simon: on it, will post updates in this thread.

perf-bot: note: new perf test added: tp_flash_qkv_stride will run nightly
